## Исходный код KubeJS скрипта
```javascript
BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

## Исходный код KubeJS скрипта

BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Some mobs (mostly monsters) need certain Light Levels to spawn. Hostile ones needing lower levels and passive needing higher ones. Using a Soul Lantern makes it so you never have to worry about Light Levels as it ignores them! This does not ignore other requirements for spawning like livestock animals needing Grass.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Spawn Count
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `6A497B063CF32A5C`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
A Fermented Spider's Eye can be used to increase the amount of mobs that CAN spawn from a spawner. The Mobs spawned is random with a Maximum amount determined by the number. It goes up or down by 1 for each eye to a maximum of 16.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 426CC475B062FC85
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `426CC475B062FC85`

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Max Entities
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `4D07B0A4A2E77CDA`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Max entities is the amount of mobs that can be spawned by a spawner and kept. If it's only 6 max entities when 6 mobs are already spawned no more will spawned until they're dead or moved. Each Ghast Tear brings it up or down 2 Entities. Max of 16 Entities and Minimum of 1.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 4DA7AE7F61B1FC05
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `4DA7AE7F61B1FC05`

## [FTB Quest] Квест: No AI

[Секция: General]
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `42D7C8CD8E6F5CD7`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
By using a Chorus Fruit on a Spawner you suck the souls out the mobs that will be spawned, only leaving a hollow husk of what they used to be. The mobs will lose all AI so they will do basically what an armor stand does. They can't hit you, can't teleport, can't move on their own. They sit there ready to be killed, how exciting!

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 7CA847C78EB1B215
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `7CA847C78EB1B215`

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Youthful
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `6F71FD826C29C31A`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
This one might be new to ones returning from earlier versions. By using a turtle egg on a spawner, it will only spawn in baby versions of the mobs in it. This only works with Vanilla baby versions of mobs, not modded.

The Spawn Range is the area of where mobs can spawn. The bigger the area, the more room for them to spawn in. The smaller the area the cheaper the factory.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:

[Секция: General]
Activation Range is how close the Player (You) must be to the Spawner for it to work. The lowest it can be is 1 block away and the highest is a 48 block radius.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Minimum Spawn Delay
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `7A9AE63998BB41FF`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
To determine when the Spawner will spawn it picks a random number between maximum and minimum spawn delay. The Minimum can be as low as 20 to as high as 32,767. Each piece of sugar modifies the min delay up or down by 10.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 5E1EDF7E617E5853

- **ID Квеста**: `5E1EDF7E617E5853`

- **ID Квеста**: `0D6D45DBA64E612D`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:

[Секция: General]
The Maximum Spawn Delay is how long it could take to spawn mobs. Just like the Minimum it can be as low as 20 to as high as 32,767. Each Clock modifies the speed of the spawner by 10. The speed is expressed in ticks where 20 ticks equals 1 second. So quickest spawn delay would be 1 second between each.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &5Enchantment Library&r is the single greatest &5Enchanted Book&r storage, ever! \
\
To Craft it you'll need 4 &3Ender Chests&r, 1 &5Enchanting Table&r, and 4 of any of the &d&lInfused&r &7Bookshelves&r: &4Infused Hellshelf&r, &bInfused Seashelves&r, and &9Deepshelves&r. \
\
To use it, you can either Shift Left Click &5Enchanted Books&r or bring them into the &9Blue Slot&r. This will add the &5Books&r to the &5Library&r. \
\
The &5Books&r are sorted by name and are held in Points. Each Level of &5Enchanted Book&r determines the Level, and it is reflected on how many &5Books&r would be needed to get that Level. Level 1, is 1 Point. Level 2 is 2 Points. Level 3 is 4 Points. Level 4 is 8 Points. \
\
Each &5Book&r is stored to a max of 32768 Points, and they can be extracted by Left Clicking the stored &5Book&r. Each Click will add another Level to the &5Book&r in the &6Orange Slot&r. \
\
You can Click different &5Books&r to add to the &5Book&r in the &6Orange Slot&r, similar to combining &5Books&r in an Anvil. \
\

[Секция: General]
The max Level of &5Enchanted Book&r is determined by the highest Level of &5Book&r you've put in. It doesn't matter if you have 32000 Points, if you only put in &5Sharpness III&r, you can only take out &5Sharpness III&r.

Two of the very first things you will need to get started in AE2 are the &bCharger&f and the &bInscriber&f.\

[Секция: General]
The &bCharger&f, when supplied with power, will take &eCertus Quartz Crystals&r and charge them. These &eCharged Certus Crystals&r can then be used in the production of &eFluix&f, another important resource in the mod. It can also be used to charge any item that stores power.\

[Секция: General]
To connect the vast majority of your ME network together, you will need some cable. &eME Glass Cable&f is the first and most basic kind of cable, and you'll be making this all throughout as the first step towards crafting the other kinds of cable.\
\
Both glass cables and their &ecovered&f counterpart can carry up to 8 channels along a single section of cabling. Unlike glass cables, covered cables can subsequently be crafted into &edense&f covered cables, capable of carrying up to 32 channels. However, most 'multipart' devices such as buses and terminals cannot be directly attached to dense cables, requiring normal-width cables to form a connection instead.\
\
All cables can also be crafted with dye to colour them. Uncoloured ('Fluix') cables can connect to any other colour of cable, but otherwise differently-coloured cables will never connect to one another.

Arguably the most important aspect of Applied Energistics 2 is its storage system, making use of digital &eStorage Cells&f. These cells are accessible through either an &eME Chest&r for single cells, or an &eME Drive&r for multiple cells.\
\
The &bME Chest&f holds a single Cell at a time, which can then be read from and written to from any other terminal on the same network. The ME Chest itself also provides its own terminal screen on the top with specific access only to the cell it contains.\
\
The &bME Drive&f can hold up to 10 assorted Storage Cells in the space of a single block and a single ME channel. However, it does not provide its own terminal screen, requiring some external terminal elsewhere on the network for storage access.

The last piece of the puzzle for any large ME network is the &bME Controller&f.
A controller supplies an ME Network with a far larger number of channels than the standard 8 channels for ad-hoc networks, providing 32 channels out of each face of the block for a total of 216 channels.
That's only for a single-block controller, however, since the ME Controller is in fact a multi-block structure. The controller can be up to 7x7x7 blocks in size and can come in any freeform arrangement within that maximum size. Each individual block can then provide its own separate set of channels, so long as no single controller block is surrounded by 4 other blocks along the same plane.

[Секция: General]
An ME Network may only contain one multiblock controller at any given time. Attempting to connect more than one controller on separate parts of the network will cause a conflict, shutting down the whole network.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
With the 1k Storage Component, you can now craft yourself a 1k ME Item Storage Cell to start your digital item storage system. You'll most likely want the majority of your storage to be for items, so you'll probably want to make a few &bME Item Storage Cells&f.

[Секция: General]
ME Item Storage Cells can each hold up to 63 different types of items. Each new type of item added to a cell will take up a certain fraction of the storage cell's total capacity in bytes. For each type already present, 1 'byte' counts for 8 items of that same type.
As an example, a 1k Item Storage Cell containing only cobblestone can hold up to 8128 cobblestone (8*1024b - 8b/type * 1 type).
If a cell is empty, it can be repurposed by disassembling it into its respective component and housing. This is done by sneaking and right-clicking in the air with the cell in your hand.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
An important concept within AE2 is a technique known as '&esubnetting&f', wherein an extra separate ME network (a &esubnetwork&f) acts in conjunction with the main network to perform some specialised function or process.

[Секция: General]
What separates a subnetwork from a completely detached separate network is usually the use of the &bQuartz Fiber&f as a cable part. When placed between two otherwise unconnected lengths of cable, the Quartz Fiber transfers no data or channels between the two whatsoever, instead only transmitting power.
Thus, a subnetwork on the other side of the Fiber can be powered wholly by the main network's power source, without requiring any extra dedicated powergen.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The Spatial Containment Structure (SCS) consists of a cage of &bSpatial Pylons&f covering the volume you wish to enclose in a Spatial IO cell. At the absolute minimum, an SCS requires three lines of spatial pylon blocks, one for each dimension of the space being contained (length, width, height).
However, Spatial IO is an extremely power-hungry feature, especially when trying to capture much larger spaces (up to 128x128x128). Having more spatial pylons included in the SCS around the desired volume will increase its overall &eefficiency&f, allowing it to use less energy to capture.
Also, be mindful that each individual pylon (regardless of its length) takes up one channel. For particularly large spaces, you may wish to build a dedicated network with a controller to fit all the required pylons.

Upon encoding, a cell is allocated a section of space within the spatial storage &edimension&f, along with a unique ID corresponding to the region allocated to the cell. An encoded cell can still be used within the Spatial IO Port to retrieve any stored blocks and entities.

In Applied Energistics 2, every ME network has a certain number of &echannels&f available, which simply means how many networked devices can fit on the whole network.\
\

[Секция: General]
As a rule of thumb, any device that more or less handles ME data directly (items stored within the network) and carries out some form of I/O will take up a channel. Usually components that are only concerned with the internal power storage of the network, like &eEnergy Cells&f and &eInscribers&f, do &onot&r take up channels.\
\
Networks without an &bME Controller&f are known as 'ad-hoc' networks and only support a maximum of 8 channels.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Now that we have our Blocks we'll need to assemble our &c&lFoundry&r. \
\
First, is &6Liquid Heating Coils&r. These will make up the floor of the &c&lFoundry&r, and are needed to Heat up the &c&lFoundry&r. \
\
The Walls will be made of &cFire Bricks&r or Windows. The Walls will also be where we place our &bDrains&f, &4Tanks&f, and &aControllers&r. \
\
The &c&lFoundry&r will not need the frame built out, so every corner can remain empty; but it must have 4 Walls and a Floor to be completed. The &aController&r will tell you where a Block is missing, if there is one. \
\
The &c&lFoundry&r can be as small as 1x1 on the inside, as long as it has a &aController&r, &6Liquid Heating Coils&r, and the other Walls filled! \
\
I don't recommend making one so small though, as the bigger the &c&lFoundry&r, the more space it has in it! \
\

You'll know the &c&lFoundry&r is built, when the &aController&r lights up like a Furnace, and the &6Liquid Heating Coils&r turn &6Orange&r.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The Assembler Matrix is a multiblock that can effectively contain multiple Molecular Assemblers and Pattern Providers, all in one channel.

[Секция: General]
The Assembler Matrix must be at least a 3x3x3 cuboid and up to a 7x7x7 cuboid. It requires the following parts:
- Edges composed of Assembler Matrix Frames
- Faces composed of Assembler Matrix Wall/Glass
- Interior composed of Assembler Matrix Pattern/Craft/Speed Core
A valid Assembler Matrix must contain at least one pattern core and craft core. It must be completely filled and can't be hollow. When the Assembler Matrix is correctly formed and powered, the lines on the frame will turn blue.
{@pagebreak}
In this example, we will be making a 7x7x7 Assembler Matrix, focused mainly on balance between craft and pattern cores.
Make the first 43 Assembler Matrix Frames and the first 125 Assembler Matrix Walls. I'll give 25 of each as a gift in the rewards for this quest (to reach a total of 68 frames and 150 walls)

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &9Deep Learner&r is one of the core components of HNN.\
\
With this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store &6Data Models&r to gather data while killing mobs.\
\
Each Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside!\
\

[Секция: General]
Note: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The first and most important &5Machine&r is the &9&lMetallurgic Infuser&r! \
\
The &9&lMetallurgic Infuser&r will combine an &eItem&r and a &cChemicals&r to Craft new &eItems&r and Alloys. \
\
&cChemicals &for &aInfuse Types&r will go into the &eYellow Square&r and will show up in the &eBar&r to the Left of it. \
\
The &4Red Square&r will hold the Item that gets Infused. \
\
The &9Dark Blue Square&r will be where the product goes to! \
\
To the Right, the &aLight Green Slot&r and &aBar&r are for &aEnergy&r! \
\
If you need to make room in the &eChemical Bar&r, use the &lDUMP&r Button. This will eject all &aChemicals&r in it!

The &d&lEnrichment Chamber&r will &dEnrich &eItems&r that go through it. Just place the &eItems&r in the &4Red Slots&r and the &dEnriched Items&r will come out of the &9Blue Slots&r. \
\
What is an &dEnriched Item&r? Or what happens when an &eItem&r gets &dEnriched&r? Either we get more of it the &eItems&r it can be made into or change the &eItem&r themselves! \
\
We can get 2 Dust from 1 Ore. We can get more Dyes from one Flower. We can even change &6Copper&r Stages or take &2Moss&r off &7Cobblestone&r! \

With later Tiers of &d&lEnrichment Chambers&r we get even more Slots to &dEnrich&f more &eItems&r at once. \
\
We also get the ability to Auto-Sort. With the press of this Button! We can set it so the Stacks of &eItems&r will be evenly distributed to each Slot so the &d&lMachine&r is more Efficient.

- **Глава**: `Mekanism`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &5&lMekanism&r &cJetpack&r works similar to &l&7Iron Jetpacks&r just with different Modes and it requires Hydrogen as Fuel instead of &aEnergy&r! \
\
Just place some Hydrogen in the &cJetpack&r by putting it in a &5Machine&r that has Hydrogen. Funny enough the &9&lElectrolytic Separator&r also has Hydrogen when it has &bOxygen&r! \
\

[Секция: General]
Once you strap it on your Back you can press (G) to switch between the Modes. \
\
&4Regular&r: hold Jump to go up, you will move in any direction you hit with WASD and if you don't you will only go up. When you release Jump Button you will Fall. \
\
&bHover&r: same controls as Default but with slower movement and you won't Fall when you release Jump. You can lower by hitting (Shift). \
\
&6Vector&r: won't respond to WASD and instead will move to where the Player is looking when holding Jump to go up. \
\
&4Disabled&r: doesn't work! \
\
By the way, you can upgrade the &cJetpack&r with a few Blocks and Items to make it have Armor Protection!

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Custom Portals!
- **Глава**: `Mekanism`
- **ID Квеста**: `7B0DFA55B4D8B16D`
- **Подзаголовок**: *Teleportation at its Finest*
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `162CE44400A63575`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
&a&lTeleporters&r will allow us to Teleport anywhere in any Dimension as long as the &5Machine&r is made and &aPowered&r! \
\
Now how do we make it and Power it? \
\

[Секция: General]
First, to make the &a&lTeleporter&r we'll need 1 &aTeleporter Block&f and 9 &aTeleporter Frames&r. \
\
The &aTeleporter Block&r is the main &aController&r of the &a&lTeleporter&r. It is the Block that will need &aEnergy&r, and once &aPowered&r we can open it. Here we can set a Network similar to the &5Quantum Entangloporter&r, type in a name and click the Checkmark to make the Network! \
\
Now when other &a&lTeleporter Structures&r or &aTeleporter Blocks&r, are set to that Network (by clicking the named Network in their GUI) you can use the &a&lTeleporter&r to obviously Teleport to the other &a&lTeleporters&r at the same Network. \
\
Now about making the &a&lTeleporter Structure&r. Place a &aTeleporter Frame&r on each side of the &aTeleporter Block&r. Above those place 3 more to make it 4 Blocks high. With 2 Blocks space above the &aTeleporter Block&r, you can place our last &aTeleporter Frames&r. \
\
Now when Powered and set, the &a&lTeleporter&r will be ready and you can walk through whatever colored Portal spawned! \
\
(You can change the Color for each in the &a&lTeleporter&r GUI!)
{@pagebreak}

[Секция: General]
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/meka_portal1.png width:200 height:75 align:center}
Place the &aTeleporter Block&r with 2 &aTeleporter Frames&r next to it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/meka_portal2.png width:150 height:125 align:center}
Now place &aTeleporter Frames&r on the previous ones.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/meka_portal3.png width:100 height:125 align:center}
Repeat.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/meka_portal4.png width:100 height:140 align:center}
Now, we'll need a whole row of &aTeleporter Frames&r for the top.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/meka_portal5.png width:110 height:150 align:center}
Once everything is set, the Portal of your choosing should appear like so!

Come on we all know what you are here for... &5&lMACHINES&r! \

[Секция: General]
&5Machines&r are our little Factories, each will do something unique in gaining us more &eItems&r. Follow the individual Quests to find out what each does. \
\
Here I will talk more on the Configs and &8Upgrades&r!
{@pagebreak}
All &5Machines&r are different but the Colors of Slots and Bars will tell what they are for! &aLight Green&f: &aEnergy&r. &4Red&f: &4Initial Item/Fluid/Chemical&f. &9Blue&f: &9Product&f. &3Cyan&f: &3Second Product&f. &eYellow&f: &eInfuse Types&r. \
\
Each &5Machine&r has default Config Sides. These are where &eItems&r will be Input and Output. You can change these in the GUI of the &5Machine&r in Side Configs. \
\
It will change for &eItems&f, &bFluids&f, &cChemicals&f, and &aEnergy&r but each has similar Sides that can be changed. &4Red&f: &5Input&f. &6Orange&f: &6Second Input&f. &9Blue&f: &9Output&f. &3Cyan&f: &3Second Output&f. &5Purple&f: &5Both Input and Output&f. &aLight Green&f: &aEnergy&f. &eYellow&f: &eExtra&f like &cInfuse Types&r. \
You'll need to set the GUI to Auto-Eject if you want &eItems&r to be Input and Output!
{@pagebreak}
Some &5Machines&r can also use &8Upgrades&r! These are in the Top Right of the GUI. \
\

In bigger &2&lReactors&r we'll need a more advanced fail safe. \

\

\
Now, let's do some &4Redstone&r! \
\
Place a &4Redstone Repeater&r facing out from the first &2FRLA&r. Then, where the &4Repeater&r is facing, place a Block that can transmit &4Redstone&r. \
\
On that Block, place a &4Redstone Torch&r in the direction that the second &2FRLA&r is. \
\

[Секция: General]
After that, place &4Redstone Dust&r next to the &4Torch&r, while on the same X/Z Level of the second &2FRLA&r. And lastly, place a second &4Redstone Repeater&r going from the &4Redstone Dust&r and into the second &2FRLA&r.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: &2Fission Reactor Logic Adapter
- **Глава**: `Mekanism Reactors`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &2Fission Reactor Logic Adapter&r ,which I will be calling &2FRLA&r, is used to monitor and configure the &2&lFission Reactor&r with &4Redstone&r. \
\
First, place the &2FRLA&r in one of the walls of the &2&lFission Reactor&r like you would with the &2Ports&r. \
\
Then, we can Right Click the &2FRLA&r to configure it. \
\
Disabled: won't interact with &4Redstone&r. \
\
Activation: will turn the &2&lReactor&r on when given a &4Redstone Signal&r, and when there is no longer a &4Signal&r it will turn off. \
\
High Temperature: will send out a &4Redstone Signal&r when the &6Temperatures&r reach a dangerous Level. \
\
Critical Waste Level: will give a &4Signal&r when there is too much &8Nuclear Waste&r. \
\

[Секция: General]
Damage Critical: will, like the others, will give out a &4Signal&r when the &2&lReactor&r is just about to blow up! \
\
Insufficient Fuel: will give a &4Signal&r when it is running out of &2Fissile Fuel&r.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
&2Fission Reactor Ports&r are pretty darn important. The &2&lFission Reactor&r will need Ports for &2Fuel&f, &bCoolant&f, and &8Waste&r... so it won't work without &2Ports&r. \
\
&2Ports&r can be placed within any parts of the &2&lFission Reactor's&r Walls, just not on the edge. \
\
We'll need to have 4 of them and we'll need to use the &3Configurator&r on the &2Ports&r to Configure them. \
\
They will start as &aInput Only&r but by Shift Right Clicking the &2Ports&r with the &3Configurator&r it will switch to &eOutput Waste&r and then to &bOutput Coolant&r. \
\
&aInput Only&r will take in both &2Fissile Fuel&r and &bCoolant&r as either &9Water&r or Sodium. \
\

[Секция: General]
&eOutput Waste&r will send &8Nuclear Waste&r out of the &2&lFission Reactor&r. \
\
&bOutput Coolant&r will either take out Steam if &9Water&r was used as the &bCoolant&r or if Sodium is used it will take out &6Superheated Sodium&r.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: &2&lFission Reactor
- **Глава**: `Mekanism Reactors`
- **ID Квеста**: `7E3C84D7FCEC9D52`
- **Подзаголовок**: *Splitting 1 Element into 2*
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `5A088F8402230BA5`, `3D2B4D9FD2086B9B`, `09D7D3CF61E156B1`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The smallest (working) &2&lFission Reactor&r we can make is 3x4x3. \
\
The base and frame will need to be made of &2Fission Reactor Casing&r while the inside will need to be either Empty, or have &2Fuel Rod Assembly&r or &2Control Rod Assembly&r! \
\
The inside of the walls (not the edges) can have our &2Fission Reactor Ports&r or &2FRLA&r and the rest can be filled with &2Reactor Glass&r. \
\
Once our &2&lFission Reactor&r is built, we can Right Click anywhere (besides the &2FRLA&r) on the &2Reactor&r to open its GUI.
{@pagebreak}
This can look pretty scary to new Players so we'll go through it slowly to understand it better! \
\

[Секция: General]
At the top, we can see 4 different Bars. These are where we can see how much &2Fissile Fuel&f, &bCoolant&f, &6Heated Coolant&f, and &8Nuclear Waste&r. \
\
Between the Bars we'll find the main menu of the &2&lReactor&r. It will tell us whether it is on or off, how &2Fissile Fuel&r is being used up every Tick, how much Temperature it rises every Tick, and how much Damage the &2&lReactor&r has suffered! \
\
Below all of these we'll see 2 Buttons! One to turn on the &2&lReactor&r saying Activate and the other to turn it off saying SCRAM. Next to the SCRAM Button is a little image to help Players know if it is on or off. Green when on, Red when off. \
\
Below those Buttons we'll see how Hot our &2&lReactor&r is and below it will show a visual of the Temperature change.
{@pagebreak}
Outside of this menu, we can Click the Top Tab to pull up the Statistics. \
\
The top Chart shows off how much Heat can be held until Damage occurs, how much room &2Fuel&r has within the &2&lReactor&r, and how Efficient it is at using Heat to use up &2Fuel&r. \
\
The rest is all based on how much &2Fuel&r can be used each Tick. We can set a max in the Type Box. It is also set at mB per Tick! \

[Секция: General]
\
The other Tab we can find on the side of the main menu is for our Temperature! \
\
It will show its Dissipiation rate as well as the Temperature Unit shown. We can change the Temperature Unit by Clicking on the Tab. You'll most likely use F (Fahrenheit) or C (Celsius) but we can also use K (Kelvin), R (Rankine), or STP (Standard Temperature and Pressure)!
{@pagebreak}
MELTDOWNS! \
\
The &2&lFission Reactor&r will explode if it goes to 250% Damage. When it explodes it will break Blocks, start Fires, and worst of all... spread &aRadiation&r! \
\
Let's avoid that! \
\
The Damage will increase when the Temperature goes over 1,200K. We'll need to use &bCoolants&r to keep that Temperature down. \
\
Make sure it has a constant supply of &bCoolant&r and make sure the &bCoolant Output&r doesn't bottle-neck. If this happens, more &bCoolant&r can't be used and the Temperature will increase. \
\
LEAKS! \
\
&aRadiation&r leaks can also occur if the &8Nuclear Waste&r Bar is full. This will spread &aRadiation&r around the &2&lReactor&r. Avoid this with constantly removing &8Nuclear Waste&r and even using &2FRLA&r to know when &8Waste&r is full!
{@pagebreak}

&4Laser Amplifiers&r have their own Internal &aEnergy&r Storage, but they don't charge like most &5Machines&r. \

\
Whether it be other &4Laser Amplifiers&f or &4Lasers&r, that is how they gain &aEnergy&r. \

They will then use that &aEnergy&r into a more focused beam by the Configs you set within its GUI. Delay, Minimum, and Maximum. \
\

[Секция: General]
Delay is how many Ticks it will wait after reaching the Minimum &aEergy&r to shoot it. The least amount of Ticks is 0 and the most is 9,999! \
\
Minimum is the amount of &aEnergy&r it will hold before shooting an even more powerful &4Laser&r! The least FE it will wait for is 800mFE while the most is 2GFE. \
\
Maximum works similar with how much it will hold before shooting the &4Laser&r.

\
If we just &cPort &5D-T Fuel&r it will Inject at the rate it is &cPorted&r into. But if we &cPort&r both &cDeuterium&r and &aTritium&r and combine it within the &c&lReactor&r we can pick any Inject Rate we want! \
\
We'll also need a little dab of &5D-T Fuel&r within a &eHohlraum&r and put that within the &c&lFusion Reactor&r for the initial start up. \
\

[Секция: General]
How do we make a &eHohlraum&r you ask? Just &9Infuse &f4 &eGold Dust&r with 10mb of &0Carbon&r within a &9&lMetallurgic Infuser&r to Craft the &eHohlraum&r. \
\
Oh wait it comes out empty, throw it into a &5Machine&r that has &5D-T Fuel&r to fill it up. Then, put it within the Slot in the &c&lFusion Reactor's&r GUI, and it is ready!

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The way the &9&lTurbine&r works is it takes in Steam via the &9Ports&r and that Steam will move the &9Blades&r on the &9Rotors&r. \

Oh wait I should probably tell you how to create the &9&lTurbine&r insides! \
\
The &9Rotors&r will be placed from the floor up within the exact center of our &9&lTurbines&r. Each &9Rotor&r can hold 2 &9Blades&r. \
\
The more &9Blades &fand &9Rotors&r the wider it will get. We won't be able to use 5x5 Base with bigger insides. \

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Before we start making &aEnergy&r let's get our Steam all over the place. We can do that by surrounding the &9Rotational Complex&r with &9Pressure Dispersers&r! \
\

[Секция: General]
Above that layer we'll need a new layer, this one full of &aElectromagnetic Coils&r. These will be moved because of the &9Rotational Complex&r, them moving with each other is what develops &aEnergy&r through their Magnetic Forces. Same thing happens with Hydroelectric Plants! \
\
Above the &aElectromagnetic Coils&r we can use &9Saturating Condensers&r which will recycle our Steam back into some &9Water&r! The &9Water&r will be extracted through the &9Vents&r.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: &9&lTurbine
- **Глава**: `Mekanism Reactors`
- **ID Квеста**: `6CCE920735187234`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `4211F29561F21643`, `02C6132919DEAF2A`, `3E5BE6D6422F682C`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &9&lTurbine&r is atleast a 5x7x5 &5Machine&r but can be expanded to hold more Steam and make more &aEnergy&r! \
\

[Секция: General]
The frame of the &9&lTurbine&r is made of &9Turbine Casings&r. The Floor and Ceiling can be filled in with &9Turbine Casings&r or Structural Glass. \
\
Before we worry about the Walls let's focus on the inside! That's the real Money-maker! \
\
In the dead center from the Floor is where our &9Rotors&r will be placed. For the smallest one we'll need 2! Then, attach the &9Blades&r on them, 4 in total. \
\
Above the highest &9Rotor&r place our &9Rotational Complex&r and surround it with &9Pressure Dispersers&r. \
\
The Layer above the &9Rotational Complex&r will be &aElectromagnetic Coils&r and above them will be our &9Saturating Condensers&r. \
\
Now we can put our &9Ports&r and &9Vents&r in our Walls and fill the rest with &9Turbine Casings&r or Structural Glass!
{@pagebreak}
Thankfully the &9&lTurbine&r is much easier to use than Build! \
\
&cTube&r in some Steam through the &9Port&r and it should start spinning. The amount of Steam it can hold is determined by the size of the entire &9&lTurbine&r Build. \
\

[Секция: General]
Then the &9Rotors &fand &9Blades&r will start spinning because of the Steam rising through the &9&lTurbine&r. This will move the &9Rotational Complex&r which moves the &aElectromagnetic Coils&r making &aEnergy&r! \
\
The &aEnergy&r can be &aCabled&r out of our 2nd &9Port&r. The amount of &aEnergy&r is determined on how fast the &9Rotors &fand &9Blades&r are moving. Which itself is determined on how much Steam is Input into the &9&lTurbine&r. \
\
If we use &9Saturating Condensers&r we'll get a little &9Water&r back from our Steam. We can take this &9Water&r out from the &9Vents&r and back into our &2&lFission Reactor&r! \
\
We do have a setting within our &9&lTurbine&r GUI which is similar to those within the &9&lElectrolytic Separator&r. We can choose to Dump Excess Steam, to constantly have it working at fastest &aEnergy&r production. We can Dump Steam, incase you want to get rid of it I guess... or Idle which is default! If you use one that isn't Idle, it won't recycle &9Water&r from Steam.
{@pagebreak}
This Multiblock can be made at any size available, not just what is shown through the Images. The Images merely show the smallest size we can make.

[Секция: General]
### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &6&lThermoelectric Boiler&r is built similar to the &2&lFission Reactor&r with the outside shell being just Casings, Glass, and Ports, while the inside is all the important stuff! \
\
The edges of the &6&lBoiler&r will need to be &6Boiler Casings&r. The Roof and Floor can be made entirely of &6Casings&r or the middle can be made with Glass! \
\
The Walls are similar, just now including &6Boiler Ports&r. \
\
The inside is where our &9Pressure Dispersers&r and &6Superheating Elements&r. \
The Roof can be given space between the Ceiling and the &9Pressure Dispersers&r to give more room for Steam. \
\
We can also give more space below the &9Pressure Dispersers&r and above the &6Superheating Elements&r to give more room for &9Water&r.
{@pagebreak}
The &6&lThermoelectric Boiler&r won't do much on its own, it'll need some &6Ports&r moving our &cChemicals&f and &bFluids&r in to start it up! \
\
Right now we'll focus on cooling &6Superheated Sodium&r! For that we'll need &6Superheated Sodium&r and &9Water&r within the &6&lBoiler&r. \
\

[Секция: General]
Once the &6Superheated Sodium&r is in, the &6&lBoiler's&r &6Temperature&r will start rising. With the &9Water&r the &6&lSuperheated Sodium&r will cool down while the &9Water&r will boil into Steam. \
\
The higher the &6Temperature&r the quicker &9Water&r will boil and &6Superheated Sodium&r will cool down. If we want/need extra &6Heat&r we can &6Conduct&r some via the &6Thermodynamic Conductors&r. \
\
We can &6Conduct Heat&r from &6Resistive Heaters&r or even &2&lFission Reactors&r!
{@pagebreak}
This Multiblock can be made at any size available, not just what is shown through the Images. The Images merely show the smallest size we can make.

[Секция: General]
You're bound to have too many items playing this modpack. It's just it works, and if you haven't figured out your storage situation yet, &dDimensional Storage&r might just be right for you!
To get started with this magical storage solution, you'll need to craft the &dDimensional Storage Actuator&r and place it down into the world. This acts just like a Shulker Box, meaning if you break it, it won't lose any of the items stored inside.
By default, this has 128 storage slots with each slot holding up to 16 stacks of an item, except for items with &5NBT&r data. These will not stack and will take up an entire slot, so make sure to leave those items out!
If you aren't sure what items have NBT data on them, you can always check out the quest "NBT and You" in the Storage questline for more info on NBT!

While you can get most of the &dOtherworld&r materials using Spiritfire, you can also use &9Divination Rods&r to locate these materials.
First, you'll need to attune the Rod to the material you are looking for. For example, if you are on the hunt for &8Otherstone&r, you can use the Rod on &aAndesite&r to help locate the Otherstone in the world.
Once attuned to a material, you can hold right click with the Rod in hand, and a particle will shoot off in the direction of the nearest material it is attuned to.
You will still need to be under the effects of the &3Third Eye&r to be able to harvest the Otherworld block.

Arguably the most useful item that you can create in Occultism, the &bIesnium Anvil&r is a super-powerful version of the Vanilla Anvil.
Created using &9Uphyxes' Inverted Tower&r, it:
- Is unbreakable.
- Increases the maximum level of all enchants for anything combined on it by one level.
- Costs half as much xp as the estimate says (rounded down, so if it says 25, it'll cost 12).
- Has a smaller experience requirement increase for repeated edits on the same item.
- Increases the maximum xp level at which you can edit items (the point at which it says "Too Expensive!").

- **Глава**: `Occultism`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Before we proceed with &dOccultism&r, it's time we learn about upgrading each type of Pentacle. Each pentacle builds off of the previous of that type.\
\
This means that rather than building separate Pentacles for each tier of Ritual (I.E. a separate pentacle for summoning &aDjinnis&r and for summoning &aFoliots&r), you can have one pentacle handle multiple tiers of Rituals. For example, &9Fatma's Incentivized Attraction&r builds off of all previous Summoning pentacles.\
\
Because of this, I suggest setting up 4 19x19 areas for each Pentacle. One for Summoning, one for Infusion, one for Possession, one for the Miscellaneous rituals (Wild and Eldritch).

The &9Reactor&r is a 3x4x3 multiblock generator that burns &aUrananite&r as fuel to produce FE.\
\
To build it, you'll need to make a total of 36 Reactor Blocks. While holding 36 in hand, placing one block will auto-build the reactor. Make sure to clear out some room first!\
\

[Секция: General]
You'll want to cool the reactor down for it to create more FE, and you can do this with either solid or liquid &bcoolant&r. To use a solid coolant, you'll also need to give it some liquid coolant as well. &bDry Ice&r makes for a great solid coolant! (Note: 1 Water Bucket will do).\
\
You can also increase the FE generation by keeping the fuel buffer full, as well as adding both Coal and Redstone to the Reactor. Using Blocks of either will also work!

### Описание и подсказки квеста:

[Секция: General]
The Breeding Chamber can be used to breed two bees with each other, automatically. It is capable of self breeding, as well as breeding 2 types of bees to make a third type (Example: Ashy Mining + Crystalline -> Iron). If this would result in a conflict (Continuing off of the earlier example, Ashy Mining + Crystalline -> Aluminium), take out one of the bees, then put it back in.
Provide breeding items in each slot (usually flowers, hold SHIFT on a bee cage holding a certain bee type to see what breeding item it uses (Draconic Bees use 2 Draconic Dust for example)) and some bee cages.
Just...don't do...whatever it takes to get the F.Bee.I. to go after you. I will ensure you get added to the Hall of Shame if they DO come after you.

Bees have varying traits that can affect how they work, when they work, their aggression, and their likelihood to lose their stinger when they attack you. In these quests I will be going over the way to get the best traits possible, as well as how to use them.\
\
To get these Gene Samples, check out the Bottler quest, which is a dependency of this one. To actually apply these Gene Samples to your bees, you will need to combine them with a Honey Treat in a crafting grid. Type works differently, and must instead be used with the Incubator to make a Spawn Egg of the respective bee.

# 🚗 FiveM: Scrap Evolution — Сайт-Витрина

Инструкция по лендингу `scrap.pp.ua`, субмодулям Git и деплою.

---

## 🌐 1. Общие сведения

- **Домен:** `https://scrap.pp.ua`
- **Репозиторий:** `https://github.com/Fro-lov/scrap_site`
- **Стек:** Next.js 16 (Turbopack), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- **Сервер:** Основной Debian VPS (`85.17.118.39`), изолированный порт `3005`
- **Версия:** `v1.0.1`

---

## 🔗 2. Архитектура с Git Submodule

Сайт и игровой сервер разделены на два независимых репозитория:
- В репозиторий сайта игровой код подключен как субмодуль:
  ```text
  scrap_site/
  ├── src/                # Исходники Next.js сайта
  ├── game-source/        # Git Submodule -> Fro-lov/scrap
  ├── Dockerfile
  └── docker-compose.yml
  ```
- Это позволяет использовать реальные компоненты интерфейса инвентаря и верстака прямо на интерактивном лендинге без дублирования кода.

---

## 🌍 3. Мультиязычность (i18n)
- Маршрутизация по префиксам URL: `/ua/`, `/ru/`, `/en/` через `proxy.ts`.
- Полная локализация интерфейса терминала, описаний и кнопок.

---

content:
## 🗄️ 2. База данных и единый источник истины

- **Архитектура:** Единая схема данных на TypeScript через Drizzle ORM (`src/server/db/schema.ts`).
- **Синхронизация:** Схема транслируется в MySQL базу данных `scrap_evolution`.
- **Таблицы:**
  - `inventories` — реестр всех хранилищ (`player`, `trunk`, `container`, `drop`, `backpack`).
  - `inventory_items` — предметы в слотах с метаданными и количеством.
  - `world_objects` & `object_templates` — интерактивные физические объекты мира (ноды скрапа, верстаки, схроны).
  - `players` — аккаунты выживших, опыт, навыки и прогресс.

header: 1. Жизненный цикл игрока (`ServerPlayer`) и Живой HUD

header: 2. Сбор металлолома (`Scrap Gathering System`) и Прокачка инженерии
content:
### 2. Сбор металлолома (`Scrap Gathering System`) и Прокачка инженерии
- [x] **Физические ноды лома (`ScrapNodeScript`):** привязка к пропам остовов авто (`prop_rub_carpart_02`) и куч металлолома (`prop_rub_scrap_01`).
- [x] **Интерактивный разбор:** анимация сбора `amb@world_human_gardener_plant@male@base` с прогресс-баром `ox_lib.progressBar` (3.5 секунды) и отменой при движении.
- [x] **Кулдаун и защита:** таймер восстановления точки 60 секунд; блокировка сбора при перегрузе инвентаря.
- [x] **Награда:** добыча ресурса `raw_scrap` и начисление `+20 EXP` в навык `engineering` с автоматическим повышением уровней.
- [x] **Автопосев точек:** автоспавн демо-точек скрапа в Сэнди-Шорс и у Госпиталя при старте сервера.

### 3. Инженерный верстак (`Engineering Blueprint Workbench`)
- [x] **Интерактивный верстак (`WorkbenchScript`):** регистрация пропов `prop_tool_bench02` в мире.
- [x] **CAD-интерфейс чертежей (`craft.tsx`):**
  - Мини-игра калибровки чертежа: интерактивное перетаскивание узлов, визуализация орбит допусков и кнопка выравнивания.
- [x] **Серверная валидация крафта:**
  - Строгая проверка ингредиентов в инвентаре, требований уровня инженерии и свободного веса.
  - 4 сбалансированных чертежа:
    1. `blueprint_refined_metal` (2x `raw_scrap` ➔ 3x `refined_metal`, +20 EXP, ур. 1).
    2. `blueprint_scrap_kit` (2x `raw_scrap` ➔ 1x `scrap_kit`, +35 EXP, ур. 1).
    3. `blueprint_medkit` (3x `raw_scrap` ➔ 1x `medkit`, +40 EXP, ур. 1).
    4. `blueprint_rad_injector` (1x `refined_metal` + 1x `raw_scrap` ➔ 1x `rad_injector`, +50 EXP, **ур. 2**).

### 4. Опасные радиационные зоны (`Hazard Radiation Zones`)
- [x] **Радиационные сектора:** Сектор крушения в Сэнди-Шорс, Свалка токсичных отходов, Эпицентр Humane Labs.
- [x] **Пространственный трекинг:** `ox_lib.Point` с радиусами 40–65м.
- [x] **Эффекты заражения:**
  - Звуковые щелчки счетчика Гейгера (`DLC_HEIST_HACKING_SNAKE_SOUNDS`).
  - Экранный шейдер искажения атмосферы `SetTimecycleModifier("NG_filmic02")`.
- [x] **Накопление дозы и урон:**
  - Серверный тик облучения раз в 2 секунды.
  - Талант «Свинцовая кожа» (`lead_skin`): поглощает 50% дозы и снижает урон на 50%.
  - Критический порог: при радиации > 70 наносится периодический урон здоровью (-5 HP).
- [x] **Медицина:** дезактивация радиации с помощью антидота `rad_injector` (-40% радиации, +10 HP) и полевой аптечки `medkit` (+35 HP).

### 5. Транспорт: Автоматический спидометр (`Speedometer HUD`)
- [x] **Детекция водителя:** проверка `GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) === ped` (активируется только за рулем).
- [x] **Телеметрия автомобиля:**
  - Скорость в км/ч (`GetEntitySpeed * 3.6`).
  - Обороты тахометра (`GetVehicleCurrentRpm * 8000`).
  - Индикация передачи (`R`, `N`, `1-6`), статус зажигания.
  - Каскадное считывание топлива: State Bag `fuel` ➔ натив `GetVehicleFuelLevel` ➔ здоровье бензобака.
- [x] **Интерфейс:** стильный неоновый полупрозрачный SVG-оверлей в правом нижнем углу без помех обзору.

### 6. Транспорт: Физический багажник и Контейнеры-схроны
- [x] **Детекция багажника:** сканирование кости `boot` или вектора задней оси авто на дистанции до 3м по нажатию клавиши `I`.
- [x] **Детекция схронов:** автоматический поиск пропов ящиков/контейнеров (`prop_crate_01a`) в радиусе 2.5м.
- [x] **Физическая анимация двери:**
  - Открытие багажника в мире игры: `SetVehicleDoorOpen(vehicle, 5, false, false)`.
  - Захлопывание двери при закрытии инвентаря: `SetVehicleDoorShut(vehicle, 5, false)`.
- [x] **Автосоздание инвентарей в БД:**
  - `trunk` — **30 слотов, 80 кг**.
  - `container` — **40 слотов, 100 кг**.
  - `drop` — **12 слотов, 20 кг**.
- [x] **Механика переноса (`moveItem`):**
  - Двухпанельный Grid-интерфейс drag-and-drop.
  - Перенос целого стака или сплит части предметов по количеству.
  - Автоматический стакинг однотипных предметов с учетом `maxStack`.
  - Строгая валидация лимита веса целевого хранилища (`canHold`).
  - Персистентное сохранение изменений в таблице `inventory_items`.

header: Сьют 1: `Core: ServerPlayer Entity & Inventory Binding` (4 теста)
content:
### Сьют 1: `Core: ServerPlayer Entity & Inventory Binding` (4 теста)
1. **Инициализация ServerPlayer с пустым инвентарем:** корректное создание экземпляра, установка ID, source, имени и привязка объекта `Inventory`.
2. **Выдача предметов игроку через player.addItem:** добавление предмета в инвентарь игрока, учет веса и проверка слота.
3. **Списание предметов через player.removeItem:** корректное уменьшение количества и удаление пустых слотов.
4. **Проверка вместимости canHoldItem с учетом веса:** валидация максимального веса инвентаря игрока.

header: Сьют 2: `Core: Scripts Lifecycle & Event Hooks` (3 теста)
content:
### Сьют 2: `Core: Scripts Lifecycle & Event Hooks` (3 теста)
5. **Вызов onPlayerJoin при входе игрока:** активация скриптов выживания и начальная выдача стартовых параметров.
6. **Вызов onStatChange при изменении характеристик игрока:** перехват события изменения здоровья/радиации/голода.
7. **Работа хуков onPlayerTick:** симуляция периодического тика выживания для подключенного игрока.

### Сьют 3: `Core: Server Tick Execution` (3 теста)
8. **Инициализация ServerTickLoop:** запуск таймера тика сервера с заданной частотой.
9. **Периодический вызов тика для активных скриптов:** передача дельты времени `deltaTimeMs` во все зарегистрированные скрипты.
10. **Остановка тика при завершении работы:** корректная очистка интервала без утечек памяти.

header: Сьют 4: `Inventory System: Item Giving, Stacking & Removal` (6 тестов)
content:
### Сьют 4: `Inventory System: Item Giving, Stacking & Removal` (6 тестов)
11. **Выдача предмета в пустой инвентарь в первый свободный слот:** проверка размещения в слоте 1 и пересчета веса.
12. **Стакинг предметов: добавление в существующий неполный слот:** слияние предметов до границы `maxStack`.
13. **Превышение maxStack:** автоматическое заполнение первого слота до упора и создание нового стака во втором слоте.
14. **Блокировка выдачи при превышении максимального веса:** отказ в добавлении, если вес превышает `maxWeight`.
15. **Списание предметов по имени из нескольких слотов:** каскадное удаление предметов из нескольких неполных стаков.
16. **Проверка наличия предметов через hasItem:** булевая проверка достаточного количества предметов для крафта или торговли.

header: Сьют 5: `Client: Inventory Manager & NUI Communication` (6 тестов)
content:
### Сьют 5: `Client: Inventory Manager & NUI Communication` (6 тестов)
17. **Открытие инвентаря игрока (`openPlayerInventory`):** сетевой запрос `onter:getInventory` и отправка NUI пакета `openInventory`.
18. **Закрытие инвентаря (`closeInventory`):** сброс NUI фокуса и отправка события закрытия в React.
19. **Открытие двухпанельного инвентаря с багажником/контейнером:** запрос двух инвентарей одновременно и передача в UI.
20. **Перемещение предметов drag-and-drop через NUI Callback:** эмуляция колбэка `moveItem` от UI и трансляция на сервер.
21. **Использование предмета через NUI Callback (`useItem`):** вызов серверного события использования предмета.
22. **Выбрасывание предмета в мир (`dropItem`):** запрос на создание дропа на земле.

header: Сьют 6: `Core: Player Lifecycle & HUD Sync` (4 теста)
content:
### Сьют 6: `Core: Player Lifecycle & HUD Sync` (4 теста)
23. **Регистрация игрока в PlayerManager при входе:** учет онлайна и индексация по `source` и `identifier`.
24. **Генерация данных HUD для клиента из ServerPlayer:** формирование пакета HP, голода, жажды, радиации и веса.
25. **Снижение показателей в тике выживания и обновление HUD:** уменьшение сытости и жажды со временем.
26. **Смерть игрока при нулевом здоровье:** отправка события гибели и вызов медицинской эвакуации.

header: Сьют 7: `Gameplay: Scrap Gathering & Engineering Skill Progression` (6 тестов)
content:
### Сьют 7: `Gameplay: Scrap Gathering & Engineering Skill Progression` (6 тестов)
27. **Проверка конфигурации нод металлолома:** корректность моделей пропов и параметров лута.
28. **Успешный сбор металлолома с начислением ресурсов:** получение 2-4 ед. `raw_scrap` и начисление опыта.
29. **Кулдаун ноды после сбора:** блокировка повторного сбора в течение 60 секунд.
30. **Защита от перегруза инвентаря при сборе:** отмена сбора и уведомление при недостатке места в рюкзаке.
31. **Прокачка навыка инженерии (+20 EXP):** рост прогресса и переход на следующий уровень.
32. **Синхронизация веса персонажа в HUD после сбора:** немедленное обновление шкалы веса в UI.

header: Сьют 8: `Gameplay: Engineering Blueprint Workbench Crafting` (8 тестов)
content:
### Сьют 8: `Gameplay: Engineering Blueprint Workbench Crafting` (8 тестов)
33. **Валидация реестра чертежей (`BLUEPRINTS_DATA`):** проверка рецептов, ингредиентов и выходных предметов.
34. **Отказ в крафте при недостатке ингредиентов:** блокировка создания изделия без требуемого сырья.
35. **Успешный крафт очищенного металла (`blueprint_refined_metal`):** списание 2 `raw_scrap` ➔ выдача 3 `refined_metal` +20 EXP.
36. **Крафт ремкомплекта (`blueprint_scrap_kit`):** списание лома ➔ выдача ремкомплекта +35 EXP.
37. **Крафт полевой аптечки (`blueprint_medkit`):** создание медикаментов на верстаке +40 EXP.
38. **Блокировка крафта высокоуровневого чертежа при низком навыке:** отказ в крафте `rad_injector` на ур. 1.
39. **Успешный крафт антирадиационного инжектора на 2 уровне инженерии:** списание очищенного металла и скрапа ➔ выдача инжектора +50 EXP.
40. **Блокировка крафта при перегрузе инвентаря:** защита от переполнения инвентаря готовой продукцией.

header: Сьют 9: `Hazard Radiation Zones & Toxicity Mechanics` (6 тестов)
content:
### Сьют 9: `Hazard Radiation Zones & Toxicity Mechanics` (6 тестов)
41. **Валидация конфигурации опасных зон (`HAZARD_RADIATION_ZONES`):** проверка координат и радиусов 3 секторов.
42. **Инициализация выжившего и проверка нулевой базовой радиации:** чистое состояние нового персонажа.
43. **Начисление дозы радиации при нахождении в зоне (`applyRadiation`):** рост уровня заражения в опасном секторе.
44. **Защита перка [lead_skin]:** поглощение 50% дозы облучения благодаря таланту «Свинцовая кожа».
45. **Критический уровень радиации (> 70) и периодический урон здоровью:** получение урона в тике выживания при сильном облучении.
46. **Применение антирадиационного инжектора и аптечки:** снижение радиации на 40% и лечение урона.

### Сьют 10: `Vehicle Trunk & Container Inventories` (6 тестов)
47. **Автосоздание инвентаря багажника автомобиля (trunk):** инициализация в БД хранилища на 30 слотов и 80 кг.
48. **Автосоздание инвентаря контейнера/схрона (container):** инициализация в БД хранилища на 40 слотов и 100 кг.
49. **Перенос предметов целиком из инвентаря в багажник (`moveItem`):** полное перемещение стака с пересчетом весов обоих хранилищ.
50. **Сплит стака при переносе части предметов (3 из 5):** разделение стака с сохранением остатка в исходном слоте.
51. **Перенос предметов из багажника обратно со стакингом:** слияние предметов с учетом лимита `maxStack`.
52. **Блокировка перемещения при превышении максимального веса багажника:** отклонение операции при попытке положить груз тяжелее 80 кг.

content:
## 🕹️ 7. Подробный чек-лист ручного тестирования (In-Game QA Guide)

Пошаговое руководство для тестирования реализованных механик непосредственно на сервере FiveM в игре.

[Секция: 🚗 Тест 1: Спидометр и телеметрия автомобиля]
### 🚗 Тест 1: Спидометр и телеметрия автомобиля
1. **Шаг 1 (Посадка за руль):** Подойдите к любому автомобилю и сядьте на место водителя (клавиша `F`).
   - **Ожидаемый результат:** В правом нижнем углу экрана автоматически появляется полупрозрачный футуристичный неоновый HUD-спидометр.
2. **Шаг 2 (Разгон и передачи):** Начните движение вперед, разгоняясь.
   - **Ожидаемый результат:**
     - Значение скорости (км/ч) динамически растет в реальном времени.
     - Шкала тахометра (RPM) заполняется в соответствии с оборотами двигателя.
     - Индикатор передачи показывает текущую ступень (`1`, `2`, `3` и т.д.). При включении заднего хода переключается на `R`. При остановке — на `N`.
     - Индикатор уровня топлива отображает актуальный процент (зеленая/бирюзовая полоса).
3. **Шаг 3 (Пассажирское сиденье):** Пересядьте на пассажирское сиденье (клавиша `G` или команда перемещения).
   - **Ожидаемый результат:** Спидометр моментально исчезает с экрана (доступен строго водителю).
4. **Шаг 4 (Выход из машины):** Выйдите из транспортного средства.
   - **Ожидаемый результат:** Спидометр полностью скрывается, экран чистый.

[Секция: 🚗 Тест 1: Спидометр и телеметрия автомобиля]

### 🧰 Тест 2: Физический багажник машины и перенос предметов
1. **Шаг 1 (Позиционирование):** Подойдите к автомобилю **сзади** на расстояние 1–2.5 метра (к крышке багажника).
2. **Шаг 2 (Открытие багажника через взаимодействие):** Откройте меню взаимодействия (Radial Menu / клавиша взаимодействия) и выберите пункт **«Открыть багажник»** (`open_trunk`).
   - *(Примечание: Нажатие клавиши `I` в любом месте открывает персональный инвентарь выжившего)*.
   - **Ожидаемый результат:**
     - Крышка багажника автомобиля **физически распахивается** в мире GTA V (`SetVehicleDoorOpen`).
     - Открывается двухпанельный интерфейс инвентаря: слева «Инвентарь игрока» (24 слота), справа «Багажник [НОМЕР_АВТО]» (30 слотов, 80 кг).
3. **Шаг 3 (Перенос предметов drag-and-drop):** Зажмите левой кнопкой мыши предмет из своего инвентаря (например, металлолом `raw_scrap` или воду) и перетащите в свободный слот багажника.
   - **Ожидаемый результат:** Предмет перемещается в багажник. Вес инвентаря персонажа в HUD уменьшается, а вес багажника увеличивается.
4. **Шаг 4 (Сплит стака):** Зажмите Shift/перетащите часть стака (например, 2 из 5 штук).

content:
## 🛠️ 7. Команды разработчика для быстрого тестирования (In-Game Dev Commands)

Для мгновенного тестирования систем без долгих поисков по карте прямо в игровой чат или консоль F8 добавлены вспомогательные команды:

| Команда | Описание | Ожидаемый результат |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/spawn_scrap` | Спавнит ноду металлолома (`prop_rub_carpart_02`) прямо перед игроком | Создается точка сбора с интерактивным разбором и кулдауном 60 сек |
| `/spawn_bench` | Спавнит инженерный верстак (`prop_tool_bench02`) прямо перед игроком | Создается интерактивный верстак для проверки чертежей и крафта |
| `/spawn_car` | Спавнит тестовый багги (`bfinjection`) перед игроком и сажает за руль | Мгновенно активируется неоновый спидометр в правом нижнем углу HUD |
| `/tp_rad` | Телепортирует игрока прямо в эпицентр радиационной зоны Сэнди-Шорс | Включается треск Гейгера, экранный шейдер и накопление дозы в HUD |
| `/spawn` | Резервная команда принудительного респавна педа | Спавнит педа в Сэнди-Шорс при отключенном автоспавне |
| `/togglehud` | Переключает видимость интерфейса выживания | Скрывает или отображает оверлей HUD |

# 🚀 Minecraft: Лаунчер GravitLauncher

Инструкция по администрированию, обновлению и обслуживанию GravitLauncher.

---

## 📦 1. Развертывание и Docker

Лаунчер работает в Docker на основном хосте (`85.17.118.39`).

### Конфигурация `docker-compose.yml`:
```yaml
services:
  gravit:
    build: .
    container_name: gravit-launcher
    restart: unless-stopped
    working_dir: /app/bin
    volumes:
      - ./app:/app
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      TZ: Europe/Kyiv
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
```

---
## 🛠️ 2. Основные операции

header: Как применить изменения в папке `app/` (новые моды/конфиги):
content:
### Как применить изменения в папке `app/` (новые моды/конфиги):
Благодаря bind mount `./app:/app`, пересобирать контейнер **не нужно**.

1. Подключиться к интерактивной консоли LaunchServer:
   ```bash
   docker attach gravit-launcher
   ```
2. Отправить команду синхронизации:
   ```text
   sync
   ```
3. **Безопасно отключиться** (не убивая процесс):
   Нажать комбинацию клавиш **`Ctrl + P`**, затем **`Ctrl + Q`**.

### Перезапуск сервиса:
```bash
docker compose restart

# или
docker restart gravit-launcher
```

### Просмотр логов:
```bash
docker logs -f gravit-launcher
```

---

## 🔐 3. Интеграция с серверами (ServerWrapper)
Игровые серверы связываются с лаунчером через WebSocket:
- Адрес: `ws://host.docker.internal:8080/api` (или внутренний IP)
- Токены проверки: `SERVERWRAPPER_CHECK_SERVER_TOKEN` в скриптах запуска серверов.

> ⚠️ **Нужна дополнительная информация:**
> - Настройка привязки скинов и личного кабинета к базе MariaDB.
> - Скрипты автообновления лаунчера на стороне клиентов.

# 🌐 Minecraft: Сайт Onter и Мониторинг

Инструкция по поддержке веб-портала `onter.pp.ua` и микросервиса мониторинга.

---

## 📁 1. Репозитории и Стек

- **Сайт Onter:** `https://github.com/Fro-lov/minecraft-site`
  - Стек: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons
  - Порт на сервере: `3000` (проксируется Nginx на `onter.pp.ua`)
- **Мониторинг Hub:** `https://github.com/Fro-lov/minecraft-monitoring`
  - Стек: Node.js (Express / Fastify), Ping & Query протоколы Minecraft
  - Порт на сервере: `3001` (Nginx `/monitoring-api/`)

## 📰 2. Форматирование Новостей (Discord Markdown)
В системе новостей сайта работает расширенный парсер с поддержкой Discord-стилей:

### Цвета текста:
`[gold]Золотой текст[/gold]`, `[green]Зеленый[/green]`, `[red]Красный[/red]`, `[sky]Голубой[/sky]`, `[purple]Фиолетовый[/purple]`

### Стилизация и спойлеры:
- `**жирный**`, `*курсив*`, `__подчеркнутый__`, `~~зачеркнутый~~`
- `||Скрытый промокод или спойлер||`
- `` `инлайн код / команда` ``

### Вставка изображений:
- `![Подпись под фото](/promo/sky/banner.png)` (картинка из `public/promo/`)
- `[img:/promo/sky/banner.png]` (тег во всю ширину)

> 🎨 **Интерактивные схемы разметки в Obsidian:**
> - [[Discord Markdown Guide.excalidraw|Excalidraw Чертеж Руководства]]
> - [[markdown_guide.canvas|Интерактивный Холст Разметки]]
> - Исходная документация: `E:\minecraft\site\minecraft-server-site\docs\MARKDOWN_GUIDE.md`

---

## 🚀 3. Деплой изменений
Деплой полностью автоматизирован через GitHub Actions Runner:
1. Делаем правки локально в коде или в `data/news.json`.
2. Коммитим и пушим в `main`:
   ```bash
   git add .
   git commit -m "feat: update news and server list"
   git push origin main

# 🎮 GameBug Shorts Engine (Автоматизация Shorts / TikTok)

## Описание проекта
Автоматизированный конвейер на Python + FFmpeg для создания коротких вертикальных видео (9:16) с разборами багов в видеоиграх.

## Расположение проекта
- **Путь кодовой базы:** `E:\social\`
- **Репозиторий / Папки:**
  - `config/`: системные настройки и пути
  - `src/core/`: TTS, генераторы 2D схем, карточек кода, нарезка YouTube, FFmpeg композитор
  - `assets/memes/`: пользовательские мемы (испуг, крест, сплющило)
  - `assets/music/`: фоновые эмбиент-треки и звуковые эффекты (колокольня)
  - `output/<episode_id>/`: структурированный вывод по эпизодам

## Принципы монтажа и сценариев
1. **Лейаут:** Геймплей вверху (`y=220`), мемы и схемы внизу (`y=860`), чтобы не перекрывать видеоряд.
2. **Схемы:** Крупные, понятные на мобильных экранах геометрические 2D-карточки без пустых эмодзи.
3. **Код / Фикс:** Забавный псевдокод в формате `[-] НЕПРАВИЛЬНО: высота = (1.0 - сила)` vs `[+] ПРАВИЛЬНО: ..., НО НЕ МЕНЬШЕ 0.5`.
4. **Аудио:** Живой темп речи Edge-TTS (+8%), фоновый эмбиент на 15% громкости, тихий SFX на появление мемов.

Подробное руководство по комплексу: [[Minecraft - Экосистема Onter]].

## 3. 🚗 FiveM: Scrap Evolution

Хардкорный survival-проект на базе платформы FiveM (постапокалипсис, скрап, радиация, крафт).

[Секция: Компоненты:]
### Компоненты:
1. **Game Server (Локальный путь: `E:\fivem\scrap_evolution\resources\onter`):**
   - Репозиторий: `https://github.com/Fro-lov/scrap` (приватный).
   - Стек: TypeScript Strict, @citizenfx, Drizzle ORM + MySQL 8.0, ox_lib, React 18 NUI, Tailwind CSS.
   - **Готовые ключевые системы:**
     - Живой HUD персонажа (HP, жажда, голод, радиация, вес в кг, компас, пульс, уровень шума).
     - Сбор лома (`ScrapNodeScript`): остовы авто, кулдауны 60с, анимация и прогресс-бар `ox_lib`, прокачка инженерии.
     - Инженерный CAD-верстак (`WorkbenchScript`): чертежи, калибровка орбит допусков, 4 рецепта.
     - Радиационные зоны (Сэнди-Шорс, Свалка, Humane Labs): трекинг `ox_lib.Point`, счетчик Гейгера, экранный шейдер, перк `lead_skin`, дезактиваторы.
     - Транспорт: неоновый спидометр (водителю, км/ч, тахометр, передачи, топливо), физический багажник по клавише `I` (распахивание/захлопывание двери, 30 слотов, 80 кг) и контейнеры (40 слотов, 100 кг).
     - Двухпанельный Grid-инвентарь с drag-and-drop переносом, сплитом, стакингом и защитой от перегруза.
   - **Тесты:** 52/52 пройденных теста (`npm test`), 10 сьютов.

[Секция: Компоненты:]
- Подробная документация: [[FiveM - Scrap Evolution Сервер]].
2. **Web Showcase / Landing:**

   - Репозиторий: `https://github.com/Fro-lov/scrap_site`.

   - Инструкция: [[FiveM - Scrap Evolution Сайт]].

## 4. 🛡️ OnterVPN (Приватный VPN-сервис)

Экосистема защищенного доступа на базе протокола AmneziaWG.

### Компоненты:
1. **Десктопный клиент (Tauri + Rust):**
   - Бинарник `OnterVPN.exe` с поддержкой Kill-Switch и автовыбора серверов.
2. **Веб-портал и Личный кабинет:**
   - Домены: `https://vpn.onter.pp.ua` и `https://ontervpn.pp.ua` (порт `:3010` на основном VPS).
   - Стек: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Google OAuth, Stripe / Card Webhooks, MariaDB `vpn_db`.
3. **Распределенный пул нод:**
   - **🇳🇱 Node 1 (Нидерланды, Амстердам):** Главный VPS (`85.17.118.39:51820`, UDP, изоляция `iptables DROP` локальных сервисов).
   - **⚡ Node 2:** Oracle Cloud 1 (`158.101.188.95:51820`, UDP, защита от спама `SMTP 25 DROP`).
   - **Node 3:** Oracle Cloud 2 (`158.180.47.202`).
4. **Панель Администратора (`/admin`):**
   - Телеметрия трафика RX/TX, статус пиров, выдача и аннулирование подписок.

Подробная инструкция: [[OnterVPN]].

## 5. 🔮 Будущие проекты и исследования

### 🧠 Universal AI Endpoint
- **Концепция:** Единый централизованный бэкенд / шлюз ко всем современным ИИ-моделям (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini).
- **Применение:** Умные NPC в FiveM, боты-гиды в Minecraft, авто-техподдержка в Discord.

### 📼 Retro PS1 Mirror Game
- **Концепция:** Атмосферная инди-игра с low-poly стилизацией эпохи PlayStation 1.
- **Сеттинг:** Сюрреалистичное зазеркалье, лиминальные пространства, TikTok-эстетика.

## 🔄 CI/CD Пайплайн (GitHub Actions)
Вся разработка ведется через Git (`https://github.com/Fro-lov`). На основном сервере развернуты выделенные воркеры:
- `actions.runner.Fro-lov-minecraft-site.truehost.service`
- `actions.runner.Fro-lov-minecraft-monitoring.truehost-monitoring.service`
- `actions.runner.Fro-lov-scrap_site.scrap-site-runner.service`
- Репозиторий VPN: `https://github.com/Fro-lov/vpn.git` (деплой через Docker Compose в `/opt/vpn-portal`).

Каждый `git push main` в соответствующий репозиторий автоматически собирает Docker-образ и перезапускает сервис с health-check проверкой.

BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

BlockEvents.rightClicked((event) => {
  const { hand, block, player, item, facing } = event
  if (hand != "MAIN_HAND") return
  if (!block.hasTag("minecraft:dirt")) return
  if (!item.isEmpty()) return
  if (!player.isShiftKeyDown()) return
  let loot = [
    "exdeorum:andesite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:basalt_pebble",
    "exdeorum:blackstone_pebble",
    "exdeorum:diorite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:granite_pebble",
    "exdeorum:deepslate_pebble"
  ]
  let random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 * loot.length)
  let dropItem = Item.of(loot[random] ?? "exdeorum:stone_pebble")
  block.popItemFromFace(dropItem, facing)
  player.swing()
})

- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`

- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Some mobs (mostly monsters) need certain Light Levels to spawn. Hostile ones needing lower levels and passive needing higher ones. Using a Soul Lantern makes it so you never have to worry about Light Levels as it ignores them! This does not ignore other requirements for spawning like livestock animals needing Grass.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Spawn Count
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `6A497B063CF32A5C`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
A Fermented Spider's Eye can be used to increase the amount of mobs that CAN spawn from a spawner. The Mobs spawned is random with a Maximum amount determined by the number. It goes up or down by 1 for each eye to a maximum of 16.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 426CC475B062FC85
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `426CC475B062FC85`

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Max Entities
- **Глава**: `Apotheosis 2`
- **ID Квеста**: `4D07B0A4A2E77CDA`
- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `310969B8FE0A94DE`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Max entities is the amount of mobs that can be spawned by a spawner and kept. If it's only 6 max entities when 6 mobs are already spawned no more will spawned until they're dead or moved. Each Ghast Tear brings it up or down 2 Entities. Max of 16 Entities and Minimum of 1.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Quest 4DA7AE7F61B1FC05

- **ID Квеста**: `4DA7AE7F61B1FC05`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &5Enchantment Library&r is the single greatest &5Enchanted Book&r storage, ever! \
\
To Craft it you'll need 4 &3Ender Chests&r, 1 &5Enchanting Table&r, and 4 of any of the &d&lInfused&r &7Bookshelves&r: &4Infused Hellshelf&r, &bInfused Seashelves&r, and &9Deepshelves&r. \

To use it, you can either Shift Left Click &5Enchanted Books&r or bring them into the &9Blue Slot&r. This will add the &5Books&r to the &5Library&r. \
\
The &5Books&r are sorted by name and are held in Points. Each Level of &5Enchanted Book&r determines the Level, and it is reflected on how many &5Books&r would be needed to get that Level. Level 1, is 1 Point. Level 2 is 2 Points. Level 3 is 4 Points. Level 4 is 8 Points. \
\
Each &5Book&r is stored to a max of 32768 Points, and they can be extracted by Left Clicking the stored &5Book&r. Each Click will add another Level to the &5Book&r in the &6Orange Slot&r. \
\
You can Click different &5Books&r to add to the &5Book&r in the &6Orange Slot&r, similar to combining &5Books&r in an Anvil. \

Arguably the most important aspect of Applied Energistics 2 is its storage system, making use of digital &eStorage Cells&f. These cells are accessible through either an &eME Chest&r for single cells, or an &eME Drive&r for multiple cells.\
\
The &bME Chest&f holds a single Cell at a time, which can then be read from and written to from any other terminal on the same network. The ME Chest itself also provides its own terminal screen on the top with specific access only to the cell it contains.\
\
The &bME Drive&f can hold up to 10 assorted Storage Cells in the space of a single block and a single ME channel. However, it does not provide its own terminal screen, requiring some external terminal elsewhere on the network for storage access.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The last piece of the puzzle for any large ME network is the &bME Controller&f.
A controller supplies an ME Network with a far larger number of channels than the standard 8 channels for ad-hoc networks, providing 32 channels out of each face of the block for a total of 216 channels.
That's only for a single-block controller, however, since the ME Controller is in fact a multi-block structure. The controller can be up to 7x7x7 blocks in size and can come in any freeform arrangement within that maximum size. Each individual block can then provide its own separate set of channels, so long as no single controller block is surrounded by 4 other blocks along the same plane.

[Секция: General]
An ME Network may only contain one multiblock controller at any given time. Attempting to connect more than one controller on separate parts of the network will cause a conflict, shutting down the whole network.

[Секция: General]

An important concept within AE2 is a technique known as '&esubnetting&f', wherein an extra separate ME network (a &esubnetwork&f) acts in conjunction with the main network to perform some specialised function or process.

[Секция: General]
What separates a subnetwork from a completely detached separate network is usually the use of the &bQuartz Fiber&f as a cable part. When placed between two otherwise unconnected lengths of cable, the Quartz Fiber transfers no data or channels between the two whatsoever, instead only transmitting power.
Thus, a subnetwork on the other side of the Fiber can be powered wholly by the main network's power source, without requiring any extra dedicated powergen.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The Spatial Containment Structure (SCS) consists of a cage of &bSpatial Pylons&f covering the volume you wish to enclose in a Spatial IO cell. At the absolute minimum, an SCS requires three lines of spatial pylon blocks, one for each dimension of the space being contained (length, width, height).
However, Spatial IO is an extremely power-hungry feature, especially when trying to capture much larger spaces (up to 128x128x128). Having more spatial pylons included in the SCS around the desired volume will increase its overall &eefficiency&f, allowing it to use less energy to capture.
Also, be mindful that each individual pylon (regardless of its length) takes up one channel. For particularly large spaces, you may wish to build a dedicated network with a controller to fit all the required pylons.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
Now that we have our Blocks we'll need to assemble our &c&lFoundry&r. \
\
First, is &6Liquid Heating Coils&r. These will make up the floor of the &c&lFoundry&r, and are needed to Heat up the &c&lFoundry&r. \
\
The Walls will be made of &cFire Bricks&r or Windows. The Walls will also be where we place our &bDrains&f, &4Tanks&f, and &aControllers&r. \
\
The &c&lFoundry&r will not need the frame built out, so every corner can remain empty; but it must have 4 Walls and a Floor to be completed. The &aController&r will tell you where a Block is missing, if there is one. \
\
The &c&lFoundry&r can be as small as 1x1 on the inside, as long as it has a &aController&r, &6Liquid Heating Coils&r, and the other Walls filled! \
\
I don't recommend making one so small though, as the bigger the &c&lFoundry&r, the more space it has in it! \
\

You'll know the &c&lFoundry&r is built, when the &aController&r lights up like a Furnace, and the &6Liquid Heating Coils&r turn &6Orange&r.

## [FTB Quest] Квест: Many Assemblers In One: The Assembler Matrix
- **Глава**: `Extended  Advanced Ae`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The Assembler Matrix is a multiblock that can effectively contain multiple Molecular Assemblers and Pattern Providers, all in one channel.

[Секция: General]
The Assembler Matrix must be at least a 3x3x3 cuboid and up to a 7x7x7 cuboid. It requires the following parts:
- Edges composed of Assembler Matrix Frames
- Faces composed of Assembler Matrix Wall/Glass
- Interior composed of Assembler Matrix Pattern/Craft/Speed Core
A valid Assembler Matrix must contain at least one pattern core and craft core. It must be completely filled and can't be hollow. When the Assembler Matrix is correctly formed and powered, the lines on the frame will turn blue.
{@pagebreak}

[Секция: General]
Like most Modded machines, Iron Furnaces has Configurations. Configs can be found by clicking the Top Left. There will be the Inputs, Outputs, and Redstone activation. The Redstone activation changes when the Furnace will smelt. The top buttons determine if it auto Inputs or Outputs, which means it will automatically move to and from connected Inventories. The Furnace Settings Linker will copy all of these settings to other Furnaces!

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &9Deep Learner&r is one of the core components of HNN.\
\
With this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store &6Data Models&r to gather data while killing mobs.\
\
Each Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside!\
\

[Секция: General]
Note: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.

- **Пререквизиты (Родительские квесты ID)**: `6F62B5510FA881CD`

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The first and most important &5Machine&r is the &9&lMetallurgic Infuser&r! \
\
The &9&lMetallurgic Infuser&r will combine an &eItem&r and a &cChemicals&r to Craft new &eItems&r and Alloys. \
\
&cChemicals &for &aInfuse Types&r will go into the &eYellow Square&r and will show up in the &eBar&r to the Left of it. \
\
The &4Red Square&r will hold the Item that gets Infused. \
\
The &9Dark Blue Square&r will be where the product goes to! \
\
To the Right, the &aLight Green Slot&r and &aBar&r are for &aEnergy&r! \
\
If you need to make room in the &eChemical Bar&r, use the &lDUMP&r Button. This will eject all &aChemicals&r in it!

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &d&lEnrichment Chamber&r will &dEnrich &eItems&r that go through it. Just place the &eItems&r in the &4Red Slots&r and the &dEnriched Items&r will come out of the &9Blue Slots&r. \
\
What is an &dEnriched Item&r? Or what happens when an &eItem&r gets &dEnriched&r? Either we get more of it the &eItems&r it can be made into or change the &eItem&r themselves! \
\
We can get 2 Dust from 1 Ore. We can get more Dyes from one Flower. We can even change &6Copper&r Stages or take &2Moss&r off &7Cobblestone&r! \
\
With later Tiers of &d&lEnrichment Chambers&r we get even more Slots to &dEnrich&f more &eItems&r at once. \
\
We also get the ability to Auto-Sort. With the press of this Button! We can set it so the Stacks of &eItems&r will be evenly distributed to each Slot so the &d&lMachine&r is more Efficient.

### Описание и подсказки квеста:
The &5&lMekanism&r &cJetpack&r works similar to &l&7Iron Jetpacks&r just with different Modes and it requires Hydrogen as Fuel instead of &aEnergy&r! \
\
Just place some Hydrogen in the &cJetpack&r by putting it in a &5Machine&r that has Hydrogen. Funny enough the &9&lElectrolytic Separator&r also has Hydrogen when it has &bOxygen&r! \
\

[Секция: General]
Once you strap it on your Back you can press (G) to switch between the Modes. \
\
&4Regular&r: hold Jump to go up, you will move in any direction you hit with WASD and if you don't you will only go up. When you release Jump Button you will Fall. \
\
&bHover&r: same controls as Default but with slower movement and you won't Fall when you release Jump. You can lower by hitting (Shift). \
\
&6Vector&r: won't respond to WASD and instead will move to where the Player is looking when holding Jump to go up. \
\
&4Disabled&r: doesn't work! \
\
By the way, you can upgrade the &cJetpack&r with a few Blocks and Items to make it have Armor Protection!
